# Root-package test shards (celeris#890). One `<shard> <TestName>` per line; # lines are comments.
#
# "The root package" below means the packages `.github/scripts/root-shards.sh pkgs` prints: the root package and
# ./test/server (the tests that need only the exported API moved there from the root directory). A name is unique across the two.
#
# The root package's tests run one after another: 543 top-level tests, ~550 s of test time, 596 s wall on
# the Unit job's runner under -race (CI run 38344043158, job 115121232279). The tests below are the ones
# that took 3 s or more there (41 of the 43). Two stay out on purpose: TestAdaptiveSettledRouteRetime592
# (the Unit job's allow-list and the Coverage job's epoll arms need it in the rest) and
# TestEnableH2UpgradeMatrix889 (internal/engine/std defines a test of that name too, which -skip would skip).
# Each shard runs in a job of its own, on its own runner (own 8 MiB RLIMIT_MEMLOCK, which two processes of one runner would
# share), and everything NOT listed here runs in the job that always ran the root package, through
# `go test -skip`. So a test that is in no list still runs; a test listed here runs in its shard only.
#
# .github/scripts/root-shards.sh check (run by both workflows) fails when a name below is not a test of the
# root package any more (renamed or removed), is listed twice, is also defined in another package (the
# Unit job's -skip would skip that one too), or when a workflow's `shard:` matrix is not exactly the shards named here (a missing or an extra shard).
# Add a test when it takes 3 s or more; keep the shards within ~10% of each other (the CI seconds below).
#
# shard a: ~221 s of CI test time, shard b: ~218 s; the rest: ~114 s (incl. TestAdaptiveSettledRouteRetime592, 37 s).
